victoria-mayor--marianne-alto.summary: Incumbent Mayor of Victoria and a former Victoria city councillor. Has also been a business owner and lives in the Burnside Gorge neighbourhood.

victoria-mayor--lyall-atkinson.summary: Born and raised in Victoria, where he has worked, owned property and operated a small business.

victoria-mayor--darren-gervais-harrison.summary: Electrical engineer and project manager who has lived in Victoria for 13 years.

victoria-mayor--christopher-hanna.summary: Fourth-generation Victorian who has worked for about 40 years as a historian and historical researcher focused on Victoria.

victoria-mayor--mike-harris.summary: Journeyman carpenter and real estate professional with more than 30 years of experience in business, construction, housing and real estate.

victoria-mayor--david-johnston.summary: Has run for mayor of Victoria in previous elections, including 2022.

victoria-mayor--bruce-mcguigan.summary: Victoria resident for more than 30 years who has worked about 25 years at local non-profit community service agencies, including in leadership roles.

victoria-council--wendy-bowkett.summary: Says she has spent more than 20 years following how City Hall decisions affect downtown, neighbourhoods, residents and local businesses.

victoria-council--jeremy-caradonna.summary: Incumbent Victoria city councillor, Capital Regional District director and transit commissioner. Has worked as a professor, civil servant and business owner; lives in Fernwood.

victoria-council--melissa-cseszko.summary: Born and raised in Victoria; has operated a small business downtown for the past six years.

victoria-council--matt-dell.summary: Incumbent councillor first elected in 2022; works in policy and legislation with the BC government. Former South Jubilee Neighbourhood Association president, musician and arts organizer.

victoria-council--shona-dion.summary: Labour activist and community builder who has been a union member for 28 years. Moved to Victoria from Vancouver in 2013.

victoria-council--jerry-garcia.summary: Downtown Victoria resident with more than 40 years of experience as an engineer, executive, project manager, entrepreneur, educator and community volunteer.

victoria-council--marg-gardiner.summary: Incumbent Victoria city councillor and business consultant who has held regulatory enforcement positions in government. Holds a BSc in chemistry and has been a community advocate for about 20 years.

victoria-council--peter-rose-gibbs.summary: Has lived in Victoria since age five, including 12 years in Fernwood. Has led campaigns on housing, climate and democratic reform and worked on federal climate legislation efforts.

victoria-council--martin-girard.summary: Advocate for marginalized people who was homeless for five years and has lived in a supportive housing complex for the past four years.

victoria-council--stephen-hammond.summary: Incumbent Victoria city councillor and non-practising lawyer who writes on workplace human rights and works as an occasional speaker and consultant. Former renters' advocate.

victoria-council--james-harasymow.summary: Has run for Victoria city council in previous elections.

victoria-council--jason-heit.summary: Entrepreneur and business owner who has lived in Greater Victoria since 1988. Vice-president of Boxing BC, founder of the Heit Foundation and a former Canadian national boxing champion.

victoria-council--susan-kim.summary: Incumbent Victoria city councillor seeking re-election and a Capital Regional District director seat; endorsed by Victoria For All.

victoria-council--bella-lee.summary: Longtime Victoria resident who rents in the Rockland neighbourhood.

victoria-council--krista-loughton.summary: Incumbent Victoria city councillor and local business owner; made the documentary film "Us & Them."

victoria-council--arthur-mcinnis.summary: Teaches law at the University of Victoria and lives in James Bay. Previously worked internationally as a construction and major-projects lawyer for contractors, financial institutions and governments.

victoria-council--karen-rothe.summary: Grew up in Victoria, where she lives and works. Has had a decades-long public-service career in planning and prevention, municipal affairs and emergency management.

victoria-council--dave-thompson.summary: Incumbent Victoria city councillor; a former lawyer and small business owner who has worked on initiatives at City Hall and the Capital Regional District.

sd61-tea5-victoria-trustee--maiya-beech.summary: Licensed early childhood educator, parent and community organizer; a BCGEU member and former bargaining committee chair.

sd61-tea5-victoria-trustee--angela-carmi.summary: Incumbent SD61 trustee. Has volunteered in SD61 classrooms since 2013 and served as a school PAC president and president of the Victoria Confederation of Parent Advisory Councils.

sd61-tea5-victoria-trustee--james-le.summary: Speech-language pathologist who has worked as a school speech-language pathologist in SD61 and SD63.

sd61-tea5-victoria-trustee--evan-llewell.summary: Born and raised in Victoria; has more than 12 years in childcare and education leadership roles and more than 10 years of community board and volunteer service.

sd61-tea5-victoria-trustee--tanner-may-p.summary: Director in the BC public service and former private-sector environmental engineer; an SD61 Parent Advisory Council member who lives in Victoria.

sd61-tea5-victoria-trustee--ann-whiteake.summary: Former SD61 trustee (2014–2022) and former president of the BC Confederation of Parent Advisory Councils, with more than 20 years in parent advocacy. Born and raised on Vancouver Island.

victoria-for-all.blurb: Describes itself as a slate working for a more caring, livable and affordable Victoria for everyone, not just the wealthy. Says it stands with renters, workers and families on housing, care services, climate resilience and community spaces.
